newsitem.title: USA: US Recession Chances Remain Low -- Comerica Index.
newsitem.headline: US Recession Chances Remain Low -- Comerica Index.

text.p: - The Recession Watch Index compiled by Comerica Bank, which forecasts the likelihood of a national recession occurring within the next 12 months, registered a 28 percent probability in February.
The index has remained at the 28 percent mark for eight months.
"The index is calling for moderate economic growth in the coming quarters, with little probability of a recession," said William Wilson, vice president and economist for Detroit-based Comerica Bank.

Comerica's Recession Watch index is designed to forecast an economic slowdown or recession well in advance, using a weighted average of three leading indicators: spread in the yield curve, adjusted bank reserve growth, and the Index of Leading Indicators.
